data.string: Take turns with {BUDDY_NAME} to blow out candles. You'll lose if you blow out the last candle.

Test your courage against the Pokémon you met! Go to the back of the room and blow out the candles.
You can blow on multiple candles in a row at the same time.
Try not to blow out the last candle, so you won't get scared in the dark room.
Blow out a candle when "Your turn!" is displayed.
You can play many times until your time runs out.
You can blow out candles in a row all at once. You can't blow past a blown-out candle. If you blow out the last candle, you lose!
Click to choose a candle you want to blow out. You can choose multiple candles in a row.
You can choose multiple candles in a row. Click "Blow Out" after your selection.
Hint: Choose a bright candle. Click "Blow Out" after your selection.
There is only one candle left! Now, you have to blow out this candle!
Your score goes up when you blow out a bright candle.
Your score goes down when you blow out a dark candle.
A big flame will become a normal flame after one blow. You need to blow on the candle twice to blow it out.
Want to quit this game? If you quit, you can't befriend {BUDDY_NAME}.
